meta.title: PhotoNote - Never forget why you took that photo
meta.description:
PhotoNote is a simple iPhone or Android app that solves a small but annoying problem: you take a photo to remember something - and later have no idea why.
With PhotoNote, you add a short note directly to your photo. The note becomes part of the image, so the context is always there - when you save it, share it, or look back at it months later.
Take a photo. Add a note. Done.

hero.title: Never forget why you took that photo
hero.lead: You know the feeling: you scroll through your camera roll and find a photo of some random object, a sofa in a Swedish furniture store, a detail of a construction site, or something you spotted on your last trip - and you have absolutely no idea what it actually was or what you wanted to remember. PhotoNote puts an end to that.
hero.visualAlt: Two phones and a polaroid showing the PhotoNote flow: take a photo, add a note, and save or share.

steps.title: Take a photo
steps.body: Open PhotoNote, hit Take Photo or pick one from your library.

steps.title: Add your note
steps.body: A title, a quick note, a rating - whatever you need to remember.

steps.title: Off it goes!
steps.body: Ready to send it, to save it, to post it - or just to never forget it!

steps.title: Find it again
steps.body: Easily find the image again with your gallery's search function

customization.heading: Switch on & off — and change the style of…
customization.hint: From simple notes to polaroids with handwritten memories - it's up to your imagination*
